# Fixture provenance

- `Core_IdleButton.SC2Layout` is an unmodified layout fixture from `SC2Mapster/SC2GameData`, Core.SC2Mod UI corpus, commit `6dd323aae4209a01f110719a00b4e8f7a88389bc`.
- `URLButton.SC2Layout` is the user-provided LaunchURLButton/template pattern, normalized only for readable indentation and used as a regression fixture.

Fixtures are used for parser, binding, StateGroup, animation, minimal-patch, and round-trip tests.
